about.title: From understanding AI to building with it
about.bio1: I hold a PhD in Computer Science from Leibniz Universität Hannover. My research examines how AI systems find, connect, and evaluate evidence across language, documents, images, and scientific literature.
about.bio2: I connect peer-reviewed research with real-world engineering across foundation models, multimodal AI, computer vision, document intelligence, and reliable evaluation. That work includes an issued U.S. patent in image privacy and de-identification.
about.bio3: Research and education are part of the same project: useful AI knowledge should be rigorous, practical, and available beyond English. Through Dr. Kabongo, I teach in English, French, Lingala, Tshiluba, and Swahili.
about.closing: Research discovers what is possible. Engineering tests it in the real world. Teaching makes the knowledge travel.

speaking.home_subtitle: I speak in English or French to research, technical, and general audiences about modern AI, applied systems, African-language technology, and technical careers.
speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.subtitle: I give talks to universities, research groups, conferences and companies — in English or French, remote or in person.
speaking.topic_1_title: What modern AI can — and cannot — do
speaking.topic_1_desc: A clear account of current capabilities, common failure modes, and how to evaluate claims without hype.
speaking.topic_2_desc: How language, vision, video, and documents come together in useful systems — from research choices to real-world trade-offs.
speaking.topic_3_desc: What it takes to build AI with and for multilingual African communities, including data, evaluation, access, and participation.
speaking.topic_4_desc: Practical lessons on finding collaborators, publishing strong work, growing technical judgment, and building a durable career.

consulting.title: Selective AI advisory
consulting.subtitle: Focused guidance for teams making consequential decisions about AI research, evaluation, architecture, and multilingual systems.
consulting.area_1_desc: Evaluation design, failure analysis, and evidence-based assessments of whether a model is fit for its intended use.
consulting.area_2_desc: Focused review of an AI system, research plan, or technical direction before a team commits significant time and resources.
consulting.area_3_desc: Data strategy, evaluation, model choices, and community-aware approaches for multilingual products and African contexts.
consulting.area_4_desc: Tailored sessions that help research and engineering teams understand a method, assess trade-offs, or align on an AI approach.
consulting.format_1_desc: A focused conversation to clarify a question, pressure-test a decision, or identify next steps.
consulting.format_2_desc: A bounded assessment of a system, dataset, architecture, evaluation plan, or research direction.
consulting.format_3_desc: A time-boxed engagement with a defined question, audience, deliverable, and end date.
consulting.boundary_body: Engagements use public or client-owned information and exclude confidential, proprietary, or employer-related work. Every enquiry is subject to conflict review and any required approvals.
consulting.cta_body: Share your organization or industry, the question, desired output, timing, and any potential conflicts. I accept only a limited number of clearly bounded engagements.
